toml:
# LEO-PNT focus area: additional PNT data services in the navigation message.
#
# A low Earth orbit (LEO) navigation message carries, besides the ephemeris and clock,
# service data: ionospheric corrections for single-frequency users (a Klobuchar-style set
# and a NeQuick-G-style set) and the system-time-to-UTC (Coordinated Universal Time)
# offset. Each service costs bits in every frame. The campaign composes four
# `leo-navmsg` encode-and-decode runs of the engine's documented Kshana LEO message frame
# (its own encoding modelled on the published message components, not any system's bit
# layout), from ephemeris and clock only to every service, and records the frame length
# and the ephemeris-and-clock share of it. A frame of B bytes takes 8*B/R seconds to
# broadcast at R bit/s, so each service's bytes are airtime on the data channel.
#
# Every frame is checked by the kind itself: a CRC-24Q (the 24-bit cyclic redundancy
# check of RTCM and SBAS) against its published check value, a decode round trip and a
# corrupted frame that must be rejected.
#
# MODELLED: bit counts of the Kshana frame; broadcast integrity flags and differential
# corrections beyond these services are not modelled.
kind = "campaign"
title = "Navigation-message service data against frame length"
seed = 20260929

[[compose.shared]]
name = "fit_interval"
unit = "s"
value = 300.0

[[compose.members]]
label = "ephemeris-clock"
bind = { fit_interval = "message.fit_interval_s" }
metrics = [
  { name = "frame_bytes", path = "encode_decode.frame_bytes", unit = "byte" },
  { name = "ephemeris_clock_bits", path = "encode_decode.ephemeris_clock_bits", unit = "bit" },
]
[compose.members.scenario]
kind = "leo-navmsg"
seed = 14
analysis = ["encode-decode"]
[compose.members.scenario.orbit]
altitude_km = 550.0
inclination_deg = 97.6
gravity_degree = 20
[compose.members.scenario.message]
model = "kepler-rac"
rac_degrees = [7, 5, 6]
fit_interval_s = 300
update_period_s = 300
svid = 4
klobuchar = false
nequick = false
utc = false
